newsitem.title: UK: Brown to end tax relief on medical insurance.
newsitem.headline: Brown to end tax relief on medical insurance.

text.p: Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown on Wednesday confirmed he was cutting VAT on fuel and power and said he was ending tax relief on medical insurance to pay for it.
"I can today announce that at this, the first opportunity, the government will honour its pledge to cut VAT on fuel and power," Brown told parliament.

"To pay for this, we will withdraw tax relief for private medical insurance for the over-60s which costs 140 million stg a year and which has failed to achieve its original purpose of substantially increasing the take-up of private medical insurance," he said.
